host-protocol.json.description: 根据用户语义组合字典原子能力，生成本轮 Tool 与 Skill 并执行。任务动作须放入 composition：Tool 的 actions 顺序执行，Skill 的 steps 组合 Tool。需要未知信息时先生成观察组合，收到结果后再生成后续组合。每次只提交一个组合。仅 system.capabilities、system.action_schema、system.health 可直接发现能力。没有预置业务 Skill。
host-protocol.json.name: omni_body

_task_profile.description: 可选的任务理解建议。轻量任务可省略；Runtime 会在工具执行前移除，并只把用户目标与真实证据作为验收权威。

composition.description: 执行任务时只提交此字段。外层不能同时出现 action、target 或 args；请把原子动作放到 tools[].actions 中。一次仅调用一次 omni_body，可在该组合内编排多个动作。

experience_refs.description: 采用用户认可的组合经验时填写对应经验 ID；必须重新适配当前输入。经验不是执行权限。

repair_of.description: 可选：正在修正的失败回执 execution_evidence.event_hash。宿主核对同一任务、同一动作的真实失败；允许纠正 target，不代表用户认可或因果已证实。

skills/catalog.json.principle: Retired compatibility index. No fixed Skill procedures are installed. Tools and Skills are generated per task from dictionary primitives.
skills/catalog.json.tool_boundary: skill router only returns skill cards; model executes flow

skills/methods/acceptance_review.json.title: Acceptance review

skills/methods/decompose_goal.json.semantic_summary: Convert a complex deliverable goal into explicit outcomes, constraints, and a reviewable work sequence.
skills/methods/decompose_goal.json.title: Goal decomposition

skills/methods/finalize_verified_artifac.semantic_summary: Finalize an artifact only after verification evidence is available, while keeping finalization distinct from completion.

skills/methods/generate_then_verify.json.semantic_summary: Produce an outcome, collect evidence, and verify the result before it can be treated as complete.
